notes.title: V1.3 — The One Where the Gantt Chart Got a Wardrobe Change
notes.description: Milestone groups now dress alike on the Gantt chart, the DAYS column learned to skip weekends and public holidays (like the rest of us wish we could), and Smart Import finally stops picking the wrong sheet. A visual and accuracy upgrade across the board.

notes.title: Colour-Coded Milestone Groups
notes.description: Each milestone and its child tasks now share the same colour on the Gantt chart — blue, violet, teal, amber, and more. No more guessing which tasks belong together. Late tasks still show red (sorry), and completed ones stay green (well done).

notes.title: Working Days, Not Calendar Days
notes.description: The DAYS column and the 'Day X of Y' counter now count only working days — weekends and South African public holidays are excluded. Because nobody's pouring concrete on Heritage Day.

notes.title: Gantt Default View: Month
notes.description: The Gantt chart now opens in month view instead of week view. Less scrolling, more big-picture thinking. You can still zoom into weeks if you enjoy the detail.

notes.title: Smarter Sheet Detection for Smart Import
notes.description: Smart Import was occasionally picking 'Sheet1' over a sheet literally named 'Project Plan.' That's been fixed. Named sheets now get a proper priority boost, and the system searches deeper into the sheet to find headers. Mondi tracker, you're welcome.

notes.title: KPI Bar Explained
notes.description: The Actual % shows how much work is done. The Expected % shows how much should be done based on time elapsed. The gap between them tells you if you're ahead or behind. Green good, red bad. That's it. That's the feature.
